{{Hatnote|For the 2007 consolidated book, see [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 1.7.1]].}}
The '''Players Committee Rules Supplement''' of 27 January 2003 is an official [[Players Committee]] rules document for early [[Virtual Original]] play.<ref name="supp2003">[https://web.archive.org/web/20030822212619/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGRules01-27-03.pdf SWCCGRules01-27-03.pdf], theforce.net (Wayback, 22 August 2003; updated 27 January 2003). Wiki copy: [[:File:SWCCG-Rules-Supplement-2003.pdf]].</ref> It supplements Decipher [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0|Rulebook 2.0]], [[Decipher Glossary 2.0]], and the [[Decipher Glossary Supplement]] of 29 January 2002.<ref name="supp2003" />

The two-page sheet includes rulings on original (V) cards such as Blaster Rack (V) and Sai'torr Kal Fas (V).<ref name="supp2003" /> [[Greg Anderson]] is named as the rules contact.<ref name="supp2003" />

[[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 1.7.1]] later replaced previous rulebooks.
